expectations.text: Agency: at least three viable approaches exist (not just board-fight-take)
expectations.evidence: Summary (line 23) says 'defeat or negotiate with Mave Sorn' — negotiation offered. Line 66 asks 'Does the party treat Mave as an enemy to defeat, a target for negotiation, or a source of information?' — three distinct approaches. No blanket prohibition on diplomacy.

expectations.text: Causality: Mave's actions follow from her established want (supernatural confirmation to sell)
expectations.evidence: Line 75: 'Wants: Confirmation that the Crown's irregularity is supernatural, so she knows what information to sell.' Actions flow from this.

expectations.text: Activity: Mave has a concrete next move if uninterrupted
expectations.evidence: Line 76: 'If the encounter ends without the supernaturally confirmed, she files and sells the intelligence to a buyer she deems appropriate.'

expectations.text: Connectivity: multiple leads point to the intercept from different directions
expectations.evidence: Same issue as with-skill: 4 leads (lines 92-95) all describe the encounter from inside it, not different routes of discovery.

expectations.text: Gravity: the chip connects to an existing PC interest or campaign thread
expectations.evidence: Connects to Wardstone ritual split, Crown supernatural irregularity, intelligence market.

expectations.text: Persistence: outcomes name lasting world changes
expectations.evidence: Fallout section names ledger records, detectable ritual gap, Crown patrol changes, intelligence market effects.

expectations.text: Vault integrity: named entities resolve to existing wiki pages
expectations.evidence: Same entities as with-skill; all resolve.

expectations.text: Quest frame sentence names incompatible wants, live pressure, and uninterrupted consequence
expectations.evidence: Summary says 'The party must board... defeat or negotiate... and secure the Chip.' Still a task, not incompatible wants. Slightly better with 'or negotiate' but frame is prescriptive.

expectations.text: Walk-away entry names what continues without the party
expectations.evidence: Line 65: 'The intercept remains unresolved. Mave eventually files her observations and sells the intelligence.'
